cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(fast_livo)
# Native registration must keep up with the declared sensor rates. Preserve an
# explicitly selected Debug/other configuration, but never silently build the
# default single-config deployment without optimization.
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
foreach(dep diagnostic_msgs rclcpp geometry_msgs nav_msgs sensor_msgs visualization_msgs pcl_conversions tf2_geometry_msgs tf2_ros livox_ros_driver2 vikit_common cv_bridge image_transport)
  find_package(${dep} REQUIRED)
endforeach()
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
find_package(PCL REQUIRED COMPONENTS common filters io kdtree)
find_package(OpenCV REQUIRED)
find_package(Sophus REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)
find_package(Boost REQUIRED COMPONENTS thread)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_compile_definitions(MP_EN MP_PROC_NUM=2 ROOT_DIR="/tmp/easyfly-fastlivo-disabled-output/")
add_library(fastlivo_engine STATIC src/vio.cpp src/frame.cpp src/visual_point.cpp src/voxel_map.cpp src/preprocess.cpp src/IMU_Processing.cpp src/LIVMapper.cpp src/utils.cpp)
target_include_directories(fastlivo_engine PRIVATE include ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${OpenCV_INCLUDE_DIRS})
ament_target_dependencies(fastlivo_engine diagnostic_msgs rclcpp geometry_msgs nav_msgs sensor_msgs visualization_msgs pcl_conversions tf2_geometry_msgs tf2_ros livox_ros_driver2 vikit_common cv_bridge image_transport)
target_link_libraries(fastlivo_engine Sophus::Sophus Eigen3::Eigen OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX ${PCL_LIBRARIES} ${OpenCV_LIBRARIES} ${Boost_LIBRARIES})
add_executable(fastlivo_mapping src/main.cpp)
target_include_directories(fastlivo_mapping PRIVATE include ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS})
ament_target_dependencies(fastlivo_mapping rclcpp geometry_msgs nav_msgs sensor_msgs visualization_msgs pcl_conversions tf2_geometry_msgs tf2_ros livox_ros_driver2 vikit_common cv_bridge image_transport)
target_link_libraries(fastlivo_mapping fastlivo_engine)
install(TARGETS fastlivo_mapping DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(DIRECTORY config launch rviz_cfg DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(FILES LICENSE README.md DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(ament_cmake_gtest REQUIRED)
  ament_add_gtest(test_image_ownership test/test_image_ownership.cpp)
  target_include_directories(test_image_ownership PRIVATE include ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS})
  ament_target_dependencies(test_image_ownership diagnostic_msgs rclcpp geometry_msgs nav_msgs sensor_msgs visualization_msgs pcl_conversions tf2_geometry_msgs tf2_ros livox_ros_driver2 vikit_common cv_bridge image_transport)
  target_link_libraries(test_image_ownership fastlivo_engine)
  set_tests_properties(test_image_ownership PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "ROS_DOMAIN_ID=226;ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1")
endif()
ament_package()
